text: Hey HN, so I made this tool in order to help me transcribe solos and melodies using YouTube videos. It's one of those little tools that I started making with AI, but this is one that I come back to and use it all the time. I love playing jazz and learning things by ear. This has made me a lot better at both, I would say.
title: Show HN: A tool for looping and transcribing YouTube Videos
